title: AMPLAI V3 meta-harness system: composable harness components, measured corpus, experiment protocol, per-cell search and dashboard
goal: The operator runs the V3 meta-harness end to end on real executions: harness components switch on/off/version per (model, reasoning effort) cell, experiments follow screening -> paired focused comparison -> ablation -> held-out -> canary with a budget-matched baseline and an explicit decision rule, a proposer drafts component edits from raw traces with predictions, and a read-only HTML dashboard shows per-cell performance, the best composition per cell, ablation contributions, lineage and pending approvals.

exclude: Protected control (design 16 section 3 class C): authority, verifier core, budget enforcement, signing, holdout
The V1/V2 development loop (.ai-team, tools/amplai-loop-kit) unless the operator widens the legacy scope

non_goals: Judge-graded domains (UI quality, visual fidelity, documents) and judge qualification
Computer use, open web search and simulated-user domains
Switching the running server's image or profile

acceptance.statement: Components are versioned records with a class; a manifest maps onto the existing composition refs; the baseline manifest renders today's execution prompt byte for byte
Environment bootstrap, memory notes, feedback form and attempt policy change the execution prompt and loop as declared and switch on and off
Cells: the operator registers a cell; Codex and Claude receive the effort; an unsupported effort is refused; qualification binding per D-097
evidence: one qualified real cell per driver

acceptance.statement: Corpus v2 has at least 40 fair tasks over at least 5 domains, three frozen splits and an active leak gate
Calibration measures per-cell pass rates with repeats and marks informative, saturated and flaky tasks
The evaluator change is qualified: stored experiments keep their verdicts; new endpoints have tests including negative controls
The proposer drafts component edits with predictions from development data only; the leak gate refuses a planted leak; prediction precision is recorded
amplai meta search runs the stages for one cell under a declared budget and stops at every human gate
The dashboard is static HTML with no script and a CSP, showing the matrix, best composition per cell, ablation, lineage and pending approvals
Legacy in the approved scope is removed with no remaining reference; migrated tests pass

A real round within the approved budget calibrates the approved cells and takes at least one proposer candidate through screening, focused and holdout, then canary and promote or a correct reject; the dashboard shows it
Verifier v2 PASS, docs RESOLVED, decisions recorded, final HTML report
